summary: Removal of misuse violation notices or regularization of permitted non-conforming activities in designated sectors.
estimated_total_cost: Penalty calculated per sq. ft. per month of violation

steps.title: Rectify violation on site
steps.description: Restore premises to sanctioned use (e.g. remove commercial storage from residential basement).

steps.title: Submit compliance affidavit
steps.description: Submit notarized undertaking on stamp paper stating non-recurrence of violation.

steps.title: Enforcement inspector re-inspection
steps.description: Building inspector re-inspects premises, measures area, and takes geo-tagged photos.

steps.title: Pay assessed compounding penalty
steps.description: Pay compounding penalty determined by the Assistant Estate Officer.

steps.title: Discharge of misuse show-cause notice
steps.description: Estate Office issues formal closure letter revoking resumption/misuse proceedings.
